charts.title: Qwen · three one-Spark recipes · Oct 1
charts.subtitle: Fixed 512-token speed screen · higher is faster
charts.description: Four final-v2 complete-recipe speed tests using the same cell-warmup-v2 protocol and fixed-cap synthetic prompts. C1 means one active request with four serial requests per group. C4 means four concurrent clients and shows total group output tokens per full group wall time, including prefill. All responses ended at the 512-token cap; this does not establish task correctness or answer quality. Recipe runtime, weight format and cache settings differ; this does not isolate a software or quantization effect.
charts.footer: Median of four groups per cell; four requests per group. C4 is whole-group aggregate. Production uses admission8; HTTP4 maintenance runs are separate.

charts.title: Qwen EXL3 · restored image · Oct 1
charts.subtitle: One DGX Spark · C1 and C4 · higher is faster · 512-token cap
charts.description: Fresh same-image test of the restored cooperative EXL3 deployment. Both settings use four backend slots. C1 sends four requests serially; C4 sends four concurrently. Rates aggregate completion tokens over the whole request group, including prefill. All outputs hit the fixed 512-token cap; this does not measure correctness or quality.
charts.footer: Median of 3 groups × 4 requests per cell. Prompt-cache state uncontrolled; all 48 outputs ended at the 512-token cap.
